prerequisites: It is recommended to have knowledge of the subjects taught in the previous courses of the Telematics itinerary.

learning_outcomes.text: Describe, analyze and select the technologies on which telematic networks, services and applications in mobile environments are based.
Interpret and analyze the architecture and operation of the GSM mobile network.
Identify the necessary elements to provide the GSM network with the capacity to transport data in packet mode (GPRS).
Interpret and analyze the architecture and operation of the UMTS mobile network.
Identify the necessary adaptations to offer high data transmission speeds over the UMTS network (HSDPA).
Know and use mobile service simulation applications to become familiar with the peculiarities of their operation.
Take initiative to provide and evaluate alternative or novel solutions to problems derived from the design, configuration and implementation of voice, data, multimedia and interactive services.
Effectively communicate (in expression and comprehension), orally and in writing, the characteristics of the designed communication services.

syllabus_topics: Services over mobile networks: STK (SIM Toolkit).
Services over mobile networks: SMS and MMS.
Services over mobile networks: Location-based services.
Ad-hoc networks: Mesh networks, MANETs, VANETs.

assessment_methods.method: Continuous evaluation of theory (2 assignments with presentation and defense)
Continuous evaluation of practices (tasks and reports)

assessment_rules: The final grade (NF) is calculated as NF = NT*0.3 + NP*0.3 + NE*0.4, where NT is theory assignments, NP is practice reports, and NE is the final exam. To pass, students must submit and defend theory assignments, submit practice reports, attend the final exam, and attend at least 70% of laboratory practice sessions. A minimum score of 5 is required for NT and NP, and a minimum of 4 for NE; otherwise, the maximum NF will be 4.5. Extraordinary and differentiated evaluations follow the same criteria and weighting, with the same minimum score requirements.
